description: Withdraw to a Pix key: build ONE Liquid transaction (provider output + explicit fee output), sign and broadcast. amount_cents is BRL cents; mode `send` = the DePix you send, `payout` = the BRL the recipient receives; recipient_tax_number is the DESTINATION Pix key holder's CPF/CNPJ. A fresh receive address of THIS wallet is sent as the refund address, so a Pix the provider cannot complete comes back here — no parameter to pass. MOVES MONEY: passes through guardrails on the GROSS before signing. Irreversible once broadcast.

amount_cents.description: Amount in BRL CENTS (integer). e.g. 1000 = R$10.00. DePix is pegged 1:1 to BRL. NOT sats.

mode.description: `send` = amount_cents is the DePix you SEND from the wallet (deposit side). `payout` = amount_cents is the BRL the recipient RECEIVES on Pix (payout side).

pix_key.description: Destination Pix key (CPF/CNPJ, email, phone, or random/EVP key).

recipient_tax_number.description: CPF/CNPJ of the HOLDER of the DESTINATION Pix key (the person receiving the payout). This is a DIFFERENT person from a deposit's payer — do not reuse the payer's document.

name: wallet_create_withdrawal

fee_address.description: Explicit (ex1) fee address, or null on the no-fee branch.

fee_cents.description: Service fee in BRL cents (null on the no-fee branch, §3.2.2).

gross_cents.description: GROSS BRL cents leaving the wallet (net + fee).

net_cents.description: NET BRL cents delivered to the payout provider.

payout_cents.description: BRL cents the recipient receives on Pix.

post_sync_failed.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) AFTER this money-moving call failed. The money already moved (see the txid); the next balance read reflects it. This is never a failure of the operation itself.

sandbox.description: true when this is a sandbox withdrawal — no on-chain leg ran.

stale.description: true when the balance refresh (sync) before this read/spend FAILED and the result reflects the last persisted snapshot — the on-chain state may be newer. Reads never fail on a provider outage; they serve the snapshot with this flag. Absent means the state was refreshed.

txid.description: Broadcast Liquid txid (null only in sandbox).

withdrawal_id.description: Withdrawal id — pass it to wallet_wait_withdrawal.

title: Create Pix withdrawal
